Extrapolating:

Blind test - The person receiving the test doesn't know which is the treatment and which is the control.

Double blind - The person administering the test doesn't know which is which either.

Triple blind - Not even the person who designed the study knows which subjects got which treatment.

Quadruple blind - No one involved at any level even knows what is attempting to be studied.

Quintuple blind - No one involved knows what a research study is.

#Humor #Science #Research
